key_numbers: No stake sizes or shareholder names given · BEI cash dividend Rp1.56T before demutualization appears only in a related headline (unconfirmed)

event: Social media posts claimed customers of PT Bank MNC Internasional (BABP) could not withdraw funds; OJK said supervision found no serious issues and urged calm.
key_numbers: Claimed Rp500,000 withdrawal cap at a Bonjer branch on 2 Nov (unverified social post) · MNC Bank Q3 headline: profit -22%, deposits -17% (headline only)

event: Finance Minister said foreign investors net bought Rp28.79T of government bonds (SBN) at the KSSK press conference, as the government says the financial system stayed stable.
key_numbers: Net foreign SBN buying Rp28.79T · 10-year SUN vs US Treasury spread 183 bps · period not stated exactly

event: Polri's Bareskrim named Presidential Chief of Staff and former Kapolri Listyo Sigit Prabowo, Kadivkum Irjen Ahrie Sonta and Irjen Eko Hadi Santoso suspects in alleged illegal wiretapping of President Prabowo's number and others, and detained them at the Mabes Polri detention centre.

event: Ex-Jampidsus Febrie Adriansyah denied before the Jakarta Tipikor Court that he extorted businessman Tan Kian for Rp55 billion, after Tan Kian and Ferry 'Boboho' testified that money was demanded to avoid suspect status in the Jiwasraya case; judges removed two spectators accused of leaking testimony. (update of E0513)
key_numbers: Rp55 billion alleged extortion · prosecution evidence shown in court · witness Boboho earlier cited Rp50 billion demand and Rp22.5 billion fee · hearing 2-3 Nov 2026

event: PKB's Muhammad Khozin said the faction is seriously studying DPR options (interpelasi, hak angket, hak menyatakan pendapat) after MA cassation ruling 742 K/TUN/2026 voided Gibran's SMA-equivalence letter; PDIP said it cannot push an angket alone, Demokrat said Gibran no longer qualifies, Golkar said it will study the full ruling. (update of E0457)
key_numbers: MA ruling 742 K/TUN/2026 · voided suket No. 9149/D.D1/KS/2019 dated 6 Aug 2019 · Art. 79(3) and 79(4)c UU MD3 · DPR in recess until 9 Nov 2026

event: KPK chair Setyo Budiyanto said ATR/BPN Minister Nusron Wahid will be summoned as a witness 'soon' in the Summarecon HGB bribery case after he missed two summonses; KPK asked him to prioritise it amid unverified reports of a Japan trip. (update of E0387)
key_numbers: Summons skipped 7 Oct and 15 Oct 2026 · 8 suspects named · OTT 14 Sep: 19 people caught, Rp106.3 billion cash seized

event: KPK spokesperson Budi Prasetyo said the PT Djarum excise-stamp probe concerns alleged underpayment of cukai through affiliated companies; searches also covered Semarang customs and the Central Java customs regional office, with money found at customs offices; no suspects named. (update of E0514)
key_numbers: Sprindik umum Oct 2026 · state loss 'hitungan awal triliunan' · 6 affiliated companies searched 29 Oct · no witnesses summoned yet (2 Nov)

event: Apple sent threat notifications to users in a reported 99 countries and Germany's BSI confirmed Bundestag members and other prominent figures received warnings of possible state-backed zero-click iPhone spyware; CNBC Indonesia's headline framed it as a 'DPR' wiretap although the article is about Germany.
key_numbers: 99 countries (figure from a Beirut filmmaker, not independently confirmed) · tens of thousands of users feared targeted · zero-click exploit · attacker unknown
